w: Today, when Swamishri came out before retiring to bed, he saw 20-25 balaks and kishores unhappy and crestfallen. Swamishri enquired why they were all so moodless. Someone said, "Because India was out of the world cup tournament." Swamishri replied, "There is no need to get tensed and unhappy. We should endeavor properly and pray. What did God tell Arjun? Do your duty but don’t desire for the fruits of your action. So, one who has spiritual knowledge (jnan) always remains happy. In worldly matters, no matter whatever that happens, we should sincerely engage ourselves in Satsang and bhakti. We should not get slack in our work or in our studies.," "We should not get unhappy in these matters. We should not get troubled or agitated in victory and failure. Why become miserable in these matters? We should pray and try the best we can. Why become disappointed? We should not get swept away by victory and failure. Apply the thought of Sankhya - we’ve never played at all! Everything was false and temporary..."
When you please God, you attain the pleasure of everyone in the world.
A true friend is one who cautions you for your good even if it may hurt you.
Like a cricket ball, which returns back each time it is hit, you should never feel bad or go away when someone scolds you, insults you or says that you are a fool.

At night, before going to rest, Pramukh Swami Maharaj came out of his room to give the devotees a memory of his darshan. To his right, 20 to 25 children, teenagers and youths were sitting with sad faces, resting their heads on their hands. Seeing them, Swamishri asked, "Why, what happened? Why are you all sitting like this?"
"Bapa! India has been knocked out of the cricket World Cup, so everyone is sad."
After hearing everything, Swamishri calmly said:

"We should not keep tension. In life, in tasks big and small, we should make proper effort. We should pray. What did God say to Arjun? Make your effort. Do not desire the fruit. So we should not be swept away in such a river of joy and sorrow. We should think with the understanding of sankhya (seeing the world as perishable). What does thinking with sankhya mean? (To a youth) They never played cricket at all. That they went there is false. They never went there. They neither won nor lost. Winning and losing is false. 'We never went to Kankaria, and no fair was ever held.'"

Swamishri arrived at Waterloo Station at 9.35 am and boarded the Eurostar train to France. Swamishri was welcomed at the Gard-Du-Word station in Paris at 1.22 pm (GMT). The evening assembly was held in a church hall.

Shilanyas Mahotsav Despite a fever Swamishri presided over the shilanyas rituals of a shikharbaddh BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir in the suburb of Lilbum in Atlanta. The rituals were also performed by 100 devotees in the foundation pit. Swamishri performed pujan of the 27 main shilas by showering flower petals. Soil from 42 countries and water from 72 rivers of the world were used during the shilanyas rituals. At 10.36 am Swamishri placed the nidhi-kumbh into the foundation pit and added cement. The participating devotees also added cement into the foundation pit. Dr K.C. Patel and Shankarbhai Patel split the auspicious coconut during as part of the rituals. Thereafter Swamishri addressed the devotees, “May the mandir that will be built here stand for thousands of years. May countless take its advantage. We pray that they be redeemed. The pujan we have done today was not an ordinary pujan. We have worshipped the master of Akshardham – Harikrishna Maharaj, His devotee Gunatitanand Swami and Yogiji Maharaj. Their blessings are always upon us. We pray that may our devotion remain robust, may we serve well and our minds be happy…” Thereafter Swamishri met and blessed about sixteen dignitaries present. The Mayor of Lilburn, Jack Bolton, presented a Key to the City to Swamishri. Swamishri, despite his illness, also attended the shilanyas assembly. Various dignitaries expressed their honor, gratitude and assistance to Swamishri for the mandir project. Jack Bolton, Mayor of Lilburn, said, “It is indeed an honor to join with you today and this historic foundation stone-laying ceremony for the new BAPS Swaminarayan Hindu Temple in Lilburn. As the mayor I welcome you to this community and as community we look forward with anticipation and excitement to this new spiritual and social center that will arise from the foundation that we set today. We are delighted that you have selected Lilbum as your new home… As community leaders we recognize the BAPS for unity in the community and work with the community for the welfare of the local and national government. We recognize the many accomplishments of the leadership and we are excited and thrilled to have and welcome His Divine Holiness. So join us today. We are honored to welcome His Divine Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj to our city. As a symbol of our respect and admiration, we are pleased to present to His Divine Holiness a Key to the City. The Key to the City is a symbol of our respect and recognition for the many accomplishments of His Divine Holiness and we look forward to you coming into our community. We extend to his Divine Holiness our utmost hospitality and courtesy during his visit to our city and wish him to return often.” Wayne Hill, Chairman of Gwinnett Commission, expressed, “I have a proclamation that I’d like to read. And I’ll apologize… This is a proclamation from Gwinnet County commending Pramukh Swami Maharaj… Whereas every religion has it’s own tradition to build houses of worship it is the mandir that builds faith in God, strengthens society and teaches people to trust one another and to become trustworthy. And whereas a mandir is a center for learning about man, nature and God. It is where ethics and values are reinforced; it is where people celebrate festivals and seek shelter in sad times. It is for talent in various arts such as sculpture, music and literature offered in the service of God. And whereas the BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha under the leadership of His Divine Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj has built more than 500 mandirs. The BAPS mandirs serve as an ideal example of spiritualism coupled with art and architecture. For they inherit peace and purity, they represent the spirit of love and harmony for the devotees.”

Kanubhai Barot and Shreyas Pandya are dedicated volunteers at the Chicago BAPS mandir. They were engaged in a mock spat before Swamishri, apparently quarrelling in the Martian language. After a while they stopped. Kanubhai explained what they were quarrelling about, “Swami, I said that Pramukh Swami is mine and Shreyas claimed that you were his. Now tell us who do you belong to?” Swamishri unhesitatingly replied, “To those who genuinely offer bhakti to God.” Everyone happily clapped at Swamishri’s wonderful answer. Then Swamishri added, “And not to those who quarrel.”

ds.t: Maharaj is ever present in satsang
w: Today was the observance of Bhagwan Swaminarayan's return to His abode. For the occasion, a scene of the atmosphere of mourning after Maharaj's departure was presented at the Smruti Mandir in Sarangpur. In it Muktanand Swami, Brahmanand Swami, Nityanand Swami, Atmanand Swami and others were consoling the sadhus in their groups. There was an atmosphere of mourning among the leading devotees such as Dada Khachar too.

Naranmuni Swami and Krishnapriya Swami, playing Muktanand Swami and Brahmanand Swami in conversation, came to Pramukh Swami Maharaj. In front was the festival murti of Shriji Maharaj. Swamishri was right in front of the murti. Both sadhus asked Gunatit Swami, standing before Maharaj, "Has Maharaj gone?" Swamishri himself, seated there as the Gunatit form, spoke out: "Maharaj Himself has said, 'I remain ever present, I remain ever present, I remain ever present.' Shriji Maharaj is certainly in satsang. Shriji Maharaj has remained ever present in Shastriji Maharaj and Yogi Bapa."
Saying this, Swamishri gave the conviction that Shriji Maharaj is always manifest in satsang.

2010.o: Celebration of Yogi Jayanti and Pramukh Varni Din
w: At 6.30 p.m. Swamishri arrived for the Sunday satsang assembly held in the mandir hall. In the beginning Viveksagar Swami gave a discourse in Hindi and thereafter children performed a traditional dance. Then Swamishri was honoured with a shawl by senior sadhus. The 60th Pramukh Varni Din was on 16 June, Wednesday, but a symbolic celebration was held today. Swamishri blessed the assembly, “As long as one does not have faith in or has not consolidated the knowledge of atma and Paramatma in oneself one can never become joyful. To make us aware of that knowledge we have the Gita, Bhagvat, Upanishads, Mahabharat, the Vachanamrut of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and the discourses of Gunatitanand Swami. By internalizing this knowledge one experiences bliss.”

The Delhi Metro train is world famous. Shreedharan Saheb, the CEO behind this Metro project, who has set a unique example for the whole world, has great love and respect for Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Today he came for Swamishri's darshan. He had had bypass surgery some time earlier, yet he did dandvat pranam, touched Swamishri's feet and sat before him.

Shreedharan Saheb said, "After the bypass operation, this is the first time I have come out in public like this. Every Sunday I usually go to an ashram, but that too had stopped until now. Today, after taking your blessings, I will start going everywhere."
Atmaswarup Swami said, "When the Metro work is going on and anyone joins, Saheb first of all gives everyone a Gita as a gift, and he also regularly gives the employees talks on morality."

Swamishri said, "That is very good. If everyone has the knowledge of the Gita, they will become happy, and if integrity comes in the employees, the work will be done well. The Shikshapatri and the Vachanamrut are also great scriptures. You should read them too."

Shreedharan Saheb gave Swamishri an account of the stages of the various Delhi Metro projects and said, "Here at Akshardham station, 10,000 people get off and on every day, and on Sundays there are even more." Having said this, he added, "At first the station was to be named 'Khelgaon Station', but people wished it, so it was named 'Akshardham'."
Swamishri said, "Even by hearing the name Akshardham, the intellect becomes good, and by coming here, life itself is transformed."

Shreedharan Saheb spoke about the Metro projects to be built in other cities of India besides Delhi. Among them he also mentioned Ahmedabad. Hearing this, Swamishri said, "Will Ahmedabad's be done soon?"
Shreedharan Saheb said, "Since it is your wish, I will take the initiative and move the work forward."
As he wished, Swamishri blessed the Ahmedabad Gandhinagar project that it would be completed quickly.

After his walk, Pramukh Swami Maharaj lay on his bed to do his exercises, and Dr Nikul said, "Today Dr Talwar, Director of the PGI in Haryana, came for darshan. I told him about your blood pressure, that many times your blood pressure even reaches zero, and many times it is only 20 or 50 or 90! Yet there is no change at all in your condition. You calmly meet everyone and even talk."
Hearing this, Dr Talwar said, "Great personalities have control over their bodies. They are not treated by doctors; they keep themselves under control."
Many obstacles had come in the building of Akshardham. In this context Anandpriya Swami asked Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "Why do obstacles come?"
Swamishri said, "When obstacles come, the work becomes that much firmer, and then no problem troubles it again."

Having said this, Swamishri remained silent for a while and then said, "God is the all doer. Sooner or later, one day or another, there is no way out but to understand this. If no obstacles come in the work we do, it does not become firm. If obstacles come, it becomes firm. You do believe God to be the doer, don't you! That is exactly what is to be believed. If it does not happen, it is God's wish, and if it happens, it is God's wish. If it is not God's wish, all that has been done will be lost. At that moment one may think, 'God did this and God did that,' but God would not have been going to do it at all! Keep this firm."
Anandpriya Swami said, "God is the destroyer of demons, so when such obstacles come, why does he not listen?"

Swamishri said, "God listens to everything. Even what is to happen may not happen, and even what is not to happen may happen. Still, believe that God alone is the all doer and keep such faith, so that one does not feel hurt or complain, 'I worked so hard, so why did this not happen?'"
Anandpriya Swami said, "You must surely have decided to kill the demons."
Swamishri said, "Our prayer should be that whether those demons die or not, the demons sitting in everyone's hearts are destroyed."

ds.p: On the flight from Ahmedabad to Delhi
w: Today Mahant Swami Maharaj flew by plane from Ahmedabad towards Delhi. Seeing Swamishri thinking, Narayanmunidas Swami asked, "What are you thinking about?"
"The universes."
"Meaning?"

Swamishri said, "Every single universe is perishable. The fourteen worlds are all a bundle. Having met Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj, we are blessed; otherwise there is nothing of substance in this universe. Because Maharaj and Swami came, this universe has become blessed."
"He practised it himself and then had others practise it..." Swamishri does not merely talk to us about thinking of the attainment, but also teaches this through his own conduct.

ds.p: On the flight from Ahmedabad to Delhi
w: Hiteshbhai Patel and Dipenbhai came. They said, "When Pramukh Swami Maharaj went to Akshardham, we prayed to you, 'May we become attached to you...' And now we have become so attached that when we meditate on Pramukh Swami Maharaj, you come naturally within a short while. And the same benefit and the same happiness that he gave is felt now too. It does not feel as if he has gone at all."
Touching a finger of his right hand to his chest, Mahant Swami Maharaj said, "It is the very same."
